Welcome to the pottery workshop!

Here's how to create your own beautiful pot:

- Drag the tools on the left (such as [icon=tool]) to sculpt the clay into any shape you like.

- While dragging a tool, rotate it using the scroll wheel.

- Dip [icon=brush] into a color from [icon=picker] to paint the clay.

- When you're finished, click [icon=ready], choose a background, and share your artwork with [icon=screenshot].

Click [u][color=#ffff00]HERE[/color][/u] to start...
